I replied to Tobias in a thread on their message in #central-random: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026, with the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. Tobias is a member of #central-team, and GBrain had the same conversation.

A ticket number is an operational fact, and everyone in #central-random is on the Central team, so posting it there is fine.
